preconditions.description: Attacker must have an existing open position in the DDSContracts contract.

exploit_hint: The vulnerability lies in the fact that the price for opening and closing positions is passed as an external argument. An attacker can exploit this by calling the function to close a position and providing an artificially inflated price. This will cause the contract to calculate an erroneously high payout, allowing the attacker to drain funds from the contract. [1, 2, 3, 5]
